accepted_reference.name: Original successful task-family pipeline
accepted_reference.scope: Preserved task-family snapshots and configurations; observed regression result, not a universal success guarantee

candidate.name: Shared contact selection and reference correction

required_comparison.first_gate: Reproduce the original 35 cases and require the candidate to preserve all 35 successes
required_comparison.repeatability: Repeat the paired regression with recorded matched random seeds and fixed dependencies; report every repetition
required_comparison.second_gate: Evaluate both full pipelines on the same predeclared harder cases, starting with bottom-drawer opening and closing
matched_conditions: task instructions and official initial states
initial visual grounding and grasp proposals when their inputs are identical
planning budgets and episode control-step limits
complete issued trajectories without execution-time vetoes
required_comparison.promotion: Preserve the original successful cases and demonstrate a measured benefit on the matched harder cases; otherwise retain the original as the accepted reference

cleanup: Compact after every run; retain evidence, videos, frozen configuration and source provenance
